verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.synthesia.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200) indexing the API documentation. Synthesia also publishes a product-level llms.txt at www.synthesia.io/llms.txt, which is cited repeatedly. So an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs for both the API and the product. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or per-page markdown versions of the docs.
